businesses.business: electrical switchgear and power distribution equipment

offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and services electrical power distribution and control equipment, including switchgear, substations and motor control centers, sold to industrial facilities, utilities and project contractors for power distribution and process control.

primary_products.value: switchgear; substations; motor control centers; bus duct; electrical house systems

primary_services.value: equipment installation support; maintenance and field service; engineering and project management; equipment upgrades and retrofits

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers, refiners, petrochemical plants, utilities, mining and data center operators, engineering and construction contractors

end_markets.value: oil and gas; petrochemicals; utilities; mining; pulp and paper; data centers; infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: switchgear and power equipment sold for industrial and utility projects; project or contract: engineered-to-order systems delivered under customer contracts; service fees: maintenance, field service, retrofits and spare parts
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds switchgear and substations from purchased components, sold to end users and contractors; service provider: provides installation support, maintenance and upgrades to installed equipment owners

geography_served.value: global: sells worldwide, with manufacturing in the United States and Canada and operations in the United Kingdom and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: switchgear, substations, motor control centers, bus duct and electrical house systems sharing industrial power customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to industrial end users, utilities and engineering contractors; partners / resellers: selected regional representatives and channel partners in some markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: must meet electrical safety and product certification standards such as UL, IEC and National Electrical Code requirements
